review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; GPNMB and Cancer: A Novel Potential Therapeutic Target, PMCID:PMC6166407
primary_title: GPNMB cooperates with neuropilin-1 to promote mammary tumor growth and engages integrin alpha5beta1 for efficient breast cancer metastasis
decision_basis: The reviews cite the primary breast-cancer study showing GPNMB associates with alpha5beta1 through its extracellular RGD motif, promotes adhesion, and recruits Src/FAK signaling linked to invasion and metastasis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve membrane or shed RGD-containing GPNMB, neuropilin-1 cooperation, alpha5beta1 complex context, and breast-cancer model; no generic integrin relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Angiopoietin-like 4 based therapeutics for proteinuria and kidney disease, PMID:24611049
primary_title: Circulating angiopoietin-like 4 links proteinuria with hypertriglyceridemia in nephrotic syndrome
decision_basis: The reviews cite the primary nephrotic-syndrome study showing circulating ANGPTL4 interacts with glomerular endothelial alphaVbeta5, with purified-integrin binding and beta5-dependent protection from proteinuria.
limitations_preserved: Preserve circulating normosialylated ANGPTL4, glomerular endothelial alphaVbeta5, glycoform and nephrotic-kidney context; no LPL or SCI inference.

review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; ANGPTL4-alphaVbeta3 interaction counteracts hypoxia-induced vascular permeability, PMID:27577973
primary_title: ANGPTL4-alphaVbeta3 interaction counteracts hypoxia-induced vascular permeability by modulating Src signalling downstream of vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2
decision_basis: The review cites the primary study showing ANGPTL4 binds alphaVbeta3 by SPR and proximity ligation, recruits Src to the integrin, and stabilizes endothelial junctions in vitro and in vivo.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ANGPTL4-alphaVbeta3 binding, Src sequestration, VEGFR2/VE-cadherin crosstalk, endothelial vascular-permeability context, and no SCI inference.

review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Human neural cell adhesion molecule L1 and rat homologue NILE are ligands for integrin alphaVbeta3, PMCID:PMC2120722
primary_title: Human neural cell adhesion molecule L1 and rat homologue NILE are ligands for integrin alpha v beta 3
decision_basis: The integrin review cites the primary study showing human L1/NILE binds alphaVbeta3 through an RGD site and supports alphaVbeta3-dependent adhesion, spreading, and haptotactic migration.
limitations_preserved: Preserve L1CAM/NILE species distinction, extracellular Ig-domain 6 RGD site, cell-cell or cell-substrate adhesion topology, and no neural SCI or autonomous integrin-relay inference.

review_locator: Cadherin 26 is an alpha integrin-binding epithelial receptor regulated during allergic inflammation, PMCID:PMC5496811; Integrin alpha4beta7: Pathogenic Roles in Metabolic and Inflammatory Diseases and Translational Therapeutics, PMID:42572795
primary_title: Cadherin 26 is an alpha integrin-binding epithelial receptor regulated during allergic inflammation
decision_basis: The primary study reports that recombinant CDH26-Fc binds recombinant alpha4beta7 and that CDH26-expressing cells adhere to alpha4beta7; the later integrin review provides the receptor-context discovery lead.
limitations_preserved: Preserve recombinant CDH26-Fc, alpha4beta7 heterodimer, calcium/divalent-cation and epithelial-leukocyte mucosal context; no CDH26 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: Cadherin 26 is an alpha integrin-binding epithelial receptor regulated during allergic inflammation, PMCID:PMC5496811; Integrin alphaE(CD103)beta7 in Epithelial Cancer, PMID:34966462
primary_title: Cadherin 26 is an alpha integrin-binding epithelial receptor regulated during allergic inflammation
decision_basis: The primary study reports biochemical co-immunoprecipitation of CDH26 with integrin alphaE; this is retained as a subunit-associated binding edge because beta7-containing receptor topology was not isolated in that assay.
limitations_preserved: Record ITGAE as a subunit-associated biochemical interaction only; do not infer alphaEbeta7 stoichiometry, adhesion relay, autonomous ITGAE signaling, or SCI relevance.
